description: This file defines the CookieSigner class for signing cookies used in Amazon CloudFront CDN. It provides methods to generate signed cookies with validation of URLs, using a key pair for cryptographic signing.

classes.name: CookieSigner
classes.description: A class to create signed CloudFront cookies for private content access, handling URL validation and cryptographic signing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CookieSigner with a key pair ID and private key

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates a signed CloudFront cookie based on URL, expiry, or policy

methods.name: validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the URL scheme to ensure it uses http or https
